gloss: to kick away; to kick aside

definitions.gloss: to kick away; to kick aside
definitions.explanation: To forcefully kick something, sending it flying away.

definitions.gloss: to kick over; to kick down
definitions.explanation: To knock something or someone down by kicking.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす。
examples.english: To kick an empty can away.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばしながら{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked while kicking stones out of my way.

examples.japanese: {邪魔|じゃま}な{箱|はこ}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばして{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: I kicked the box out of the way and passed through.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす。
{怒|いか}りでゴミ{箱|ばこ}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばした。
examples.english: In anger, I kicked the trash can over.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}に{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばされたボールが{遠|とお}くまで{転|ころ}がっていった。
examples.english: The ball that the dog kicked went rolling far away.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{蹴|け}る (to kick) + {飛|と}ばす (to make fly, to send away)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を to mark the object being kicked

ASPECT ({ている}):
{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばしている indicates the action is in progress or habitual.

REGISTER:
Neutral to casual. Often used in informal contexts.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす: to push/shove away
- {殴|なぐ}り{飛|と}ばす: to punch and send flying
- {吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ばす: to blow away

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick an empty can
- {石|いし}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick a stone away
- {人|ひと}を{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick someone away (violent)
